subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The duke had capacity. but his life was so ________ that what influence he had upon the king was for evil.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lewd**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lewd** means obscene or vulgar in a sexual way. (कामुक)
 
• The sentence suggests that the duke's behaviour was so inappropriate that it had a negative impact on the king.
 
• The word "**capacity**" implies that the duke had some kind of power or influence. (क्षमता)
 
• The phrase "**for evil**" indicates that the duke's influence was harmful or malicious.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *The duke had capacity. but his life was so lewd __that what influence he had upon the king was for evil. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Seditious **means inciting rebellion against a government or authority. (विद्रोहात्मक)
 
• **Scrumptious **means delicious or appetizing. (शानदार)
 
• **Ambitious **means having a strong desire to achieve something or succeed. (महत्वाकांक्षी)
